verdict.rationale: The only versioning evidence is the live runtime probe hitting a v1-prefixed endpoint (api.skyfire.xyz/api/v1/tokens/introspect), which implies path-based API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, a changelog, or version lifecycle guarantees, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, documented versioning scheme/changelog, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
